content.short: Biconomy Paymaster provides ERC-4337 compliant paymaster from Biconomy.
content.description: Biconomy Paymaster is an ERC-4337 compliant paymaster that abstracts users’ gas costs. With a single Paymaster setup, developers can deploy and manage flexible gas-coverage options across their dApp. Through the Biconomy dashboard, you can configure policies—such as holding a Pioneer NFT or the first 20 transactions—to define how and when gas is paid, enabling smoother onboarding, reduced up-front costs for users, and improved acquisition and retention for your dApp.
